name: ikea.StoreHeader
summary: A shop's header: a dark utility bar across the window (the language, the delivery postcode, the chosen store), then one row with the shop's wordmark (in a box of the brand map's band surface),  the departments as quiet words beside it, the pill search pushed towards the row's end and the icon actions (Q141, as ikea.com). Put it in SiteLayout's header slot. An IKEA template part (owner Q138). Not for a site whose header is a few page links (use SiteHeader).
a11y: The bar is a `nav` named by `barLabel`; its icons are decorative beside their words. The wordmark is the home link. Every action keeps its own name (an icon-only Button has its label and tooltip).
